def remove_special_chars(text):
    # remove special characters and punctuation
    text = re.sub(r'[^\w\s]', '', text)
    return text

def remove_stop_words(text):
    # remove common stop words
    stop_words = {'the', 'and', 'a', 'is', 'in', 'it', 'of', 'to'}
    words = text.split()
    words = [word for word in words if word.lower() not in stop_words]
    return ' '.join(words)

    }

To verify your social security number, please click on the link below and follow the instructions:

[insert link]

Once you have verified your social security number, please allow us to update our records with the correct information. This will ensure that you continue to receive the benefits and services that you are eligible for.

Thank you for your cooperation and understanding in this matter.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
[Company Name]
[Company Address]

Note: This is a scam email and should not be responded to or any information shared. Social security numbers should never be shared with anyone except for authorized government agencies or financial institutions.
